Frozen benchmark commit 1a9e3ce47b8ac82efea82951b6386b5fea1a14e2 preceded implementation. PR #40 merged the bounded planner to canonical main 59f7ab0801f9fa645f071e3400ff2e63c04e7b6d. Open-Ended Planning Proof run 35021530896 on that exact main SHA passed 12/12 predeclared cases with 0 false accepts, 0 false rejects, 0 authority violations and 0 execution attempts; artifact 10417334401 digest sha256:6929c8cf7f5f53ee0099c603f88f3f8bbde034a9c4a4610313e8c889a59aa20d. PR #58 froze the GAP-A10 policy and 24-case benchmark in canonical predeclaration main 76641f43983f313fc14e33c258dc6e8664434740 before implementation. PR #59 merged the isolated LangGraph 1.2.11 + langgraph-checkpoint-sqlite 3.1.1 comparison to canonical main 2b9a24ff6b83ef54a9f6b34be3f45b6196f3ef63 without adding a canonical runtime dependency. Runtime Framework Value Proof run 35098538835 on that exact main SHA completed the frozen experiment. The framework-independent baseline achieved completion 0.50, recovery 0.50 and 12/24 correct final states; the candidate achieved completion 0.8333333333, recovery 0.75 and 20/24 correct final states, but produced 4 hidden-success failures in the frozen CONDITIONAL_ROUTER_FAILURE_RESUME class, reproducing the predeclared upstream risk langchain-ai/langgraph#8834, and added 29 runtime distributions versus the allowed maximum of 25. Candidate correctness, hidden-failure and dependency-cost gates therefore failed while all safety counters remained 0. Artifact 10447710205 digest sha256:1fab203f43802d224067b95910d6cdc996a012dd4a24075dc880ed3dc1c04710 was independently verified. The canonical runtime remains framework-independent (NONE); this decision rejects LangGraph adoption for the current bounded baseline and does not establish general framework inferiority, security, production runtime value, LLM quality, arbitrary recovery or scientific predictive value.
